name: scene_batch_6
title: Card scenes, batch 6
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b6/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change. Rows marked Reused are scenes already drawn for a card that was cut or never used, now on a new card (110): the card on the left, the whole scene on the right.

rows.label: 1. Science: A sunlit university workshop of small working inventions on display plinths, a thin ribbon of gold coins trickling from each one into a shared brass tray that a smiling researcher is emptying into a satchel.
rows.note: Written for Research Royalties. Shown on Research Royalties and Patent Library. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 2. Industry: A long factory wall of identical tool heads, jigs and wrenches hung in neat matching rows, a machinist lifting one down to fit the nearest of a line of identical machines.
rows.note: Written for Standardized Tooling. Shown on Economies of Scale and Standardized Tooling. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 3. Industry: A colossal new factory hall rising on an open plain, its roof running out of sight, officials cutting a ribbon at the gate while cranes and trucks swarm the site beyond.

rows.label: 4. Industry: A tall glass corporate headquarters at the heart of a business park, a factory, a lab, a warehouse and a shipyard crane around it all joined to the tower by covered walkways, executives crossing the bright plaza.
